summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV (formerly Galapagos) filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, disclosing a weekly buyback under its repurchase program announced June 9, 2026. Between August 17-21, 2026, the company repurchased 117,471 ordinary shares at an average price of EUR 24.40 (range EUR 23.66-25.70) across Euronext Amsterdam and other venues, totaling approximately EUR 2.87 million. As of August 21, 2026, Lakefront holds 1,033,528 treasury shares. This is a routine buyback disclosure, representing a capital return to shareholders. Watch for continued periodic repurchase updates and aggregate progress against the program's total authorization.
